title: Field Lab
description: An electric-field sandbox — place charges, watch field lines, iron filings, potential heat, and vector grids reshape in real time.
concept: Field Lab turns Coulomb's law into a playground: tap to drop positive or negative point charges, drag them around, and switch between four live visualizations of the resulting electric field. Five presets (dipole, quadrupole, capacitor plates, charge ring, random cluster) demonstrate classic field patterns, and every configuration can be exported as a PNG, saved locally, or shared via a compact URL hash.
features: Tap to place +/- charges with adjustable magnitude, drag to move, double-tap to delete
Four field visualization modes: animated field lines, iron-filing particle tracers, potential heatmap, and a vector arrow grid
Five physics presets: dipole, quadrupole, capacitor plates, charge ring, random cluster
PNG export, named localStorage saves with load/delete, and shareable btoa/atob URL-hash links

interaction.mouse: Click empty space to place a charge, drag existing charges to move them, double-click to delete
interaction.click: Toggle polarity and adjust magnitude/density sliders in the bottom panel
interaction.touch: Tap to place, drag to move, double-tap to delete — fully touch-driven on mobile
interaction.keyboard: No keyboard shortcuts required; all controls are pointer/touch driven
